questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to leave to a country that was very different from Denmark, and have had an interest in South Korea's culture and the popularity of it for some time.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The exchange was great, however there was some things in the beginning of the exchange where I wish there had been more information from the host university.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Not that easy, it was somewhat difficult at times and I thought that they did not really care about the exchange students as much.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was very limited - the most assistance I got was from the exchange coordinator through email

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: dormitory was available

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: there was a cooking facility that was of use to all

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: it is fun to get to know other students and where they are from, but it is very limited space and you have to share one room, so privacy is not there

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *

How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: registration was fairly easy as I remember it

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: you can register through the website

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: the exchange coordinator and school gave much help through the process

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: the registration for the classes was difficult, especially for master students. It was a diffcult system that was first come first serve and they had two types of registration: one offline and one online.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be quick to know what courses you want - it is a good idea to register to the courses for international because they are usually for bachelor and master
